knowledge:
- key_parameters: bw_positive=Strand-specific positive bigWig file path for truncation or C-to-T events ;; bw_negative=Strand-specific negative bigWig file path for truncation or C-to-T events ;; sampleName=Character string defining the metadata column name for the assigned counts ;; colname_reads=Column name in the GRanges object containing the mean truncation reads ;; colname_C2T=Column name in the GRanges object containing the mean C-to-T transitions ;; normalization=Logical, whether to normalize numerical features (relative signal strength and C-to-T transitions) by the ratio of the mean between the input dataset and the training set (set to TRUE for real data, FALSE for small test datasets) ;; genome=The second argument of m6Aboost specifying the BSgenome package name (e.g., "BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10")
- alternatives: PureCLIP is recommended for initial peak calling before running the m6Aboost workflow.
- when_to_use: Use when you have miCLIP2 peak calling results and want to accurately filter out background signals and identify high-confidence single-nucleotide resolution m6A sites.
- pitfalls: Ensure peaks are filtered for reproducibility (present in at least two replicates) before running the workflow ;; Always download the correct BSgenome package and GENCODE GFF3 annotation file beforehand ;; For real datasets, do not set normalization = FALSE as experimental variation in signal strength and C-to-T transitions can affect prediction accuracy.

workflows.name: m6a_prediction_from_miclip2
workflows.intent: Predict m6A sites from miCLIP2 peak calling results and signal bigWig files.
workflows.stages: 1. Assign truncation events to peaks using truncationAssignment ;; 2. Assign C-to-T transitions to peaks using CtoTAssignment ;; 3. Calculate mean truncation and C-to-T counts across replicates ;; 4. Extract features using preparingData with the GFF3 annotation ;; 5. Predict m6A sites using m6Aboost with a BSgenome package
workflows.code:
test <- truncationAssignment(test, 
    bw_positive=truncationBw_p,
    bw_negative=truncationBw_n,
    sampleName = "WT1")

test <- CtoTAssignment(test, 
    bw_positive=ctotBw_p,
    bw_negative=ctotBw_n,
    sampleName = "CtoT_WT1")

# peak$WTmean <- (peak$WT1 + peak$WT2)/2

test <- preparingData(test, test_gff3, colname_reads="WTmean", 
    colname_C2T="CtoTmean")

out <- m6Aboost(test, "BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10", normalization = FALSE)
